item.title: Google Cloud introduces Agent Compute Engine to host AI agents
item.description:
Google LLC’s cloud unit today introduced Agent Compute Engine, an infrastructure service optimized to host artificial intelligence agents. AI agents run in technology environments called sandboxes. They host the applications, data and user instructions that agents need to carry out their work. Sandboxes also contain cybersecurity guardrails that block malicious activity.
